error.invalid_json: The robot did not understand the request.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.none.title: Calibrate your robot
calibration.none.text: You will set how far each axis may travel and where the wand rests. Stay next to the robot: during Calibration it can go beyond its usual limits, slowly. Remove the wand's toy if it could hit something.
calibration.horizontal_min.title: Horizontal minimum
calibration.horizontal_min.text: Horizontal minimum = the smallest angle = where the arm goes with the joystick fully LEFT. The arm first moves to the current minimum. Lower the value (−) until the arm is as far left as it may go, stopping just before anything touches or strains, then mark it.
calibration.horizontal_max.title: Horizontal maximum
calibration.horizontal_max.text: Horizontal maximum = the largest angle = joystick fully RIGHT. Raise the value (+) until the arm is as far right as it may go, stopping just before anything touches, then mark it. It must be above the minimum.
calibration.vertical_min.title: Vertical minimum
calibration.vertical_min.text: Vertical minimum = the smallest angle = where the arm goes with the joystick fully DOWN. The arm first moves to the current minimum. Lower the value (−) until the arm is as low as it may go, stopping just before anything touches or strains, then mark it.
calibration.vertical_max.title: Vertical maximum
calibration.vertical_max.text: Vertical maximum = the largest angle = joystick fully UP. Raise the value (+) until the arm is as high as it may go, stopping just before anything touches, then mark it. It must be above the minimum.
calibration.stow.title: Stow position
calibration.stow.text: The arm moves to the current Stow position. Nudge both axes to where the wand should rest when it is put away, within the limits shown. The servos are released there, so pick a position where the arm stays put on its own.
calibration.sweep.title: Checking the envelope
calibration.sweep.text: Watch the robot: it slowly visits the four corners of the new limits, then returns to the Stow position. Press Cancel if anything touches.
calibration.confirm.title: Did everything stay clear?
calibration.confirm.text: If nothing touched or strained during the sweep, save the new limits. Otherwise start over.
calibration.done: Calibration saved. The robot now uses its new limits.
banner.uncalibrated: Not calibrated yet: movement is limited to a small safe range.
settings.limits.hint: Fine-tune the values found by Calibration. They apply once Calibration has been completed.
error.invalid_request: The robot did not understand the request.
settings.hardware.hint: Which GPIO drives each servo and its direction; under Servo travel, its pulse range. Saving restarts the robot. Changing the direction or pulse range resets Calibration, since the limits would no longer match.
settings.restarting_recalibrate: Saved. The robot is restarting; run Calibration again afterwards.
error.pin_not_allowed: {axis}: this pin can't drive a servo on this chip.
error.pin_duplicate: Both servos can't use the same pin.
error.pulse_out_of_range: {axis}: pulses must be between 300 and 2700 µs, at least 500 µs apart.
settings.device.hint: The name also sets the robot's address and its hotspot's name. Saving restarts the robot.
settings.name: Name
settings.name_saved: Saved. The robot is restarting and will answer at http://{host}/
error.invalid_name: Use 1 to 32 characters, including at least one letter or digit.
info.title: Info
info.report: Include these details when you report a problem.
info.name: Name
diag.title: Diagnostic report
diag.hint: What the robot knows about itself, with your Wi-Fi name, addresses and broker details hidden. Attach it to a bug report: on GitHub or Discord it will be public.
diag.selected: Report selected: copy it with your browser.
diag.unavailable: The report could not be loaded. Check the connection to the robot.
diag.full.title: Full report, for your own use
diag.full.hint: Includes your Wi-Fi name, the IP and MAC addresses and the broker details. Keep it to yourself; never post it in public.
pin.title: Settings PIN
pin.text: Enter the robot's PIN to change its settings.
pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {seconds} s.
security.title: Settings PIN
security.hint: With a PIN, anyone on your Wi-Fi can still play and Stow, but changing limits, Calibration, wiring, name, Wi-Fi, Home Assistant or firmware asks for it. Forgot it? Erase and reflash the robot.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.
firmware.title: Firmware update
firmware.hint: Choose the .bin file for your chip from the latest release (the file whose name ends in -ota.bin). Settings and Calibration are kept. If the upload fails, the robot keeps its current firmware.
firmware.done: Installed. The robot is restarting; this page will reload.
error.not_firmware: This file is not an ESP32 firmware.
error.wrong_chip: This firmware is for another chip. Pick the file for your board's chip (see the Info page).
error.update_failed: The update failed. The robot keeps its current firmware.
error.upload_interrupted: The upload was interrupted. The robot keeps its current firmware; try again.
mqtt.title: Home Assistant
mqtt.hint: Connect the robot to the MQTT broker of your Home Assistant (for example the Mosquitto add-on). It then appears in Home Assistant by itself, with Stow, positions and maximum speeds. Leave it off if you don't use Home Assistant.
error.mqtt_port_invalid: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
mqtt.error.unreachable: Can't reach the broker. Check its address and port.
mqtt.error.bad_credentials: The broker refused the user or password.
error.travel_order_at: {axis}: the maximum must be above the minimum ({min}°).
settings.pulse.title: Servo travel (advanced)
settings.pulse.hint: The pulse width the servo receives at 0° and at 180°. It sets how far the servo turns, not how fast: speed is set under Speed and acceleration, above. Widen the range if the servo turns less than half a turn from end to end; narrow it if the servo buzzes or strains at its ends. Most servos work with the defaults.
setup.skip.hint: Use the robot from this hotspot for now. You can connect it to your Wi-Fi later in Settings → Network.
settings.wifi.hotspot: Not on your Wi-Fi: you are using the robot through its own hotspot.
settings.about.hint: Firmware, chip, memory, Wi-Fi state and the Diagnostic report for bug reports.
calibration.reverse.horizontal: Does − move the arm RIGHT instead of left? Tick "Reverse this axis": the arm stays put, the values are mirrored, and this axis starts over at its minimum.
calibration.reverse.vertical: Does − move the arm UP instead of down? Tick "Reverse this axis": the arm stays put, the values are mirrored, and this axis starts over at its minimum.
calibration.reverse.done: Axis reversed. Lowering the value now moves the arm the other way.
firmware.hotspot: You are on the robot's hotspot. If this page opened in your phone's Wi-Fi sign-in window, it cannot pick a file: open this address in your regular browser (Chrome, Safari…) while still on the hotspot, then upload from there.
setup.skip.browser: To update the firmware from the hotspot, open the robot in your regular browser rather than this sign-in window: http://192.168.4.1/
help.title: Help
help.question.title: Ask a question
help.question.hint: Build help, settings, ideas: the CatWandConnect Discord, in English, French and other languages. No GitHub account needed.
help.bug.title: Report a problem
help.bug.hint: Describe what went wrong. The robot adds its Diagnostic report (your Wi-Fi name, addresses and broker details are hidden) and prepares a bug report on GitHub.
help.bug.what.placeholder: I pressed Stow while the wand was moving, and it kept moving for 2 seconds.
help.bug.public: This exact text will be PUBLIC on GitHub. Check it before going on.
help.bug.trimmed: The oldest log lines were left out to fit. The downloaded report has them all: attach it to the issue.
help.bug.account: Opening the issue needs a GitHub account and an internet connection on this phone. No account? Post the report in #support on Discord instead.
help.bug.opened: The report was downloaded: drag it into the issue before submitting it.
help.security: Found a security problem? Never report it in public:
pending.banner: A problem report saved on the hotspot is waiting.
pending.title: Saved report
pending.hint: You described a problem while the robot was on its hotspot. Send it now that you are back online, or discard it. It is never sent by itself.
pending.offline: No internet on the robot's hotspot? Save the report on the robot and send it once it is on your Wi-Fi.
pending.saved: Saved on the robot. Once it is on your Wi-Fi, the main screen will offer to send it.
pending.failed: The report could not be saved.
setup.problem.hint: Download the robot's Diagnostic report (your Wi-Fi name and addresses are hidden), or describe the problem and save it for later. Questions: discord.gg/Rbqge3v9dk
setup.problem.save: Describe it and save for later
